cards.question: Sign the standing rule? Reversible grants are approved without asking.

options.label: Auto-approve grants that are narrow, revocable, end within 90 days and reach no pay, sign, send-to-person or delete op, no wildcard and no owner root key. At most 50 a day, each with a receipt.
options.signs: decision.card standing rule P0 option A: approve without asking every grant that is revocable, ends within 90 days of its ask, has exact scopes (no wildcard) and reaches no pay, sign, send-to-person or delete op and no owner root key (reach table of decision.card config ours). At most 50 a day, each with a hash-chained receipt. Ends 90 days after signing; Revoke ends it at once.

options.label: As A, and also grants that reach owner root keys.
options.signs: decision.card standing rule P0 option B: as option A, and also grants that reach owner root keys. At most 50 a day, each with a hash-chained receipt. Ends 90 days after signing; Revoke ends it at once.

options.label: Do not sign: every grant keeps arriving as a row.
options.signs: decision.card standing rule P0 option C: no standing rule; every grant is asked one by one.

cards.because: A is the rule as you stated it on 21 Nov; the reach test keeps money, law, messages and deletes as cards.

no_answer.then: nothing is applied; the waiting grants stay unapplied
no_answer.cost: live-frontend stays on the simulator; 3 asks wait
